message: `body.grounded` belongs to the physics subsystem and is read-only.
notes: `grounded` is the result of the last completed `move_character`
help: move the body with `move_character(displacement, rotation)`; it is grounded when the move finds ground within `snap_to_ground`

message: `body.ground_normal` belongs to the physics subsystem and is read-only.
notes: `ground_normal` is the result of the last completed `move_character`, zero when not grounded
help: move the body with `move_character(displacement, rotation)`
